question: Can stationary band-limited noise be rejected without losing legitimate symbol-clock detections?

seeds.note: Development used seeds 0-99 (noise) and 0-24 (clocks) and test seeds 0,3,17,99. Every seed here is >= 1000.

path: production: ring -> channelize (STRUCTURE_CHANNEL) -> detect(); INSUFFICIENT_WINDOW and channelizer refusals are counted separately and never as crossings or misses

adverse_noise.role: PINNED adverse controls (v1 failure mechanism); gate G1

novel_noise.role: families NOT used during v2 development; exploratory, flagged not gated; gate G4

families.two_band: two passbands, each width/2 wide, centred at +/- width/2
families.am_random_walk: raised-edge noise multiplied by a slowly varying positive envelope (random walk, low-passed)

sensitivity.note: noise_sigma is the per-component std added to a unit-power-pulse-normalised signal, as in the existing fixtures; it is not an SNR claim

edge_window.role: direct statistic on the first N channelized samples; gate G3
edge_window.note: OUT OF CONTRACT: production refuses N < 32768 (INSUFFICIENT_WINDOW); lengths are at or above that

gates.G1_specificity: for EVERY adverse_noise cell, v2 crossings == 0 of the analysable trials (Wilson 95% upper bound <= 0.05 at n=80)
gates.G2_sensitivity: for EVERY sensitivity cell where v1 detects >= 18 of 20, v2 detects >= 18 of 20
gates.G3_edge: v2 has 0 noise crossings at every length, and v2 clock detections >= v1 clock detections - 3 of 30 at every length
gates.G4_novel: reported; ANY v2 crossing is recorded as a blocking finding for any replacement recommendation but does not alter G1
gates.decision: G1 and G2 and G3 all pass => 'SUPPORTED FOR FURTHER SHADOW VALIDATION'. Otherwise 'NOT SUPPORTED'. No outcome of this protocol is a recommendation to replace v1 or change a production threshold.

threshold_independent: ROC AUC of (noise statistic vs clock statistic) is reported per sensitivity condition against pooled adverse noise, for v1 and v2, as a check that the shipped threshold is not carrying the result
